output.rationale: The requirement specifies semi-flush panel mounting of instruments, relays, and control devices on switchgear front doors. Among the candidates, 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear lineup, which aligns with the specification for metal-clad switchgear. This product is engineered-to-order (ETO), suitable for the described technical requirement.
